CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_site_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$select exists(select 1 from public.site_admins where user_id=(select auth.uid()))$function$

functions.name: refresh_guide_rating
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_guide_rating(p_guide_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update public.guides g set
 average_quality=(select round(avg(r.quality)::numeric,2) from public.reviews r where r.guide_id=p_guide_id and r.status='published'),
 would_book_again_pct=(select round(100.0*avg((r.would_book_again)::int),2) from public.reviews r where r.guide_id=p_guide_id and r.status='published'),
 review_count=(select count(*) from public.reviews r where r.guide_id=p_guide_id and r.status='published'),
 updated_at=now()
 where g.id=p_guide_id;
end $function$

functions.name: reviews_rating_trigger
throttle_review_submission
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.throttle_review_submission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
if exists(select 1 from public.guide_claims c where c.guide_id=new.guide_id and c.claimant_id=new.author_id and c.status='approved') then
 raise exception 'You cannot review a guide profile you own'; end if;
if (select count(*) from public.reviews r where r.author_id=new.author_id and r.created_at>now()-interval '24 hours')>=3 then
 raise exception 'Review limit reached. Please try again later'; end if;
return new;end $function$

relations.name: admin_pending_claims
relations.view:
SELECT c.id,
    c.guide_id,
    g.full_name AS guide_name,
    c.claimant_id,
    c.created_at,
    e.claimant_name,
    e.business_name,
    e.public_evidence
   FROM guide_claims c
     JOIN guides g ON g.id = c.guide_id
     LEFT JOIN claim_evidence e ON e.claim_id = c.id
  WHERE c.status = 'pending'::text;

relations.name: admin_pending_reviews
relations.view:
SELECT r.id,
    r.guide_id,
    g.full_name AS guide_name,
    r.body,
    r.quality,
    r.safety,
    r.communication,
    r.professionalism,
    r.created_at,
    r.trip_month
   FROM reviews r
     JOIN guides g ON g.id = r.guide_id
  WHERE r.status = 'pending'::text;

relations.name: public_angler_reviews
relations.view:
SELECT id,
    guide_id,
    quality,
    intensity,
    would_book_again,
    catch_outcome,
    body,
    trip_month,
    published_at,
    communication,
    professionalism,
    safety,
    equipment,
    knowledge,
    effort,
    value_rating,
    trip_context
   FROM reviews
  WHERE status = 'published'::text AND published_at IS NOT NULL;
